Sugar Painting Stories in Chengdu's Wide & Narrow Alleys

👤 小雨 12岁 · 中国成都Xiaoyu, 12 · Chengdu, China

我采访了做了30年糖画的张爷爷，记录了他的手艺流程和心愿。希望更多年轻人能看到这门手艺！

I interviewed Grandpa Zhang, who's been making sugar paintings for 30 years. I documented his craft process and wishes. Hope more young people discover this art!

那不勒斯披萨的家族传承

Neapolitan Pizza: A Family Legacy

👤 Marco 14岁 · 意大利那不勒斯Marco, 14 · Naples, Italy

我的家族三代人都在做传统披萨。我记录了从面团发酵到窑烤的全过程，还对比了中美意三种披萨文化！

My family has made traditional pizza for three generations. I documented the entire process from dough fermentation to wood-fired baking, and compared pizza cultures across China, US, and Italy!
